svg.text: fast-sandbox integration environment (OpenSandbox side) - how it works

scripts/fast-sandbox-env · two-node kind + KVM passthrough · fast-sandbox@master · firecracker pool with egress attached (Sandbox Actions channel) and P2P delivery (DART) by default · initializes environment + pool only, no sandboxes
1. Host and kind cluster topology (steady state after up)

cgroup v2 is a hard kind prerequisite
kind node A (control-plane, untainted - both nodes schedule)
single process, no leader election · pool/fastlet creation + capacity heartbeats · janitor DS on both nodes
init container downloads firecracker v1.16.1 + jailer + vmlinux 6.1 to hostPath
(6.1 kernel has VMGenID: reseeds CRNG at snapshot restore, avoids execd hangs)
must complete before fastlet starts - pool injects hostPath File mounts; missing binaries break the Pod
UDS API: PinImage + lease mgmt (shared hostPath)
Pod: fastlet (pool-managed · one per node, anti-affinity)
microVM slots x5 - restored on demand at sandbox create (guest 172.30.0.3 · execd :44772)
same passthrough and labels as node A - both nodes schedulable is what makes the P2P topology work
environment init stops here (no sandbox creation); create later with fastctl / verify-egress
same assets onto node B: firecracker/jailer/vmlinux to hostPath
downloads: GitHub release + s3 (production: private mirror + pinned)
identical to A: UDS · PinImage · leases
cache miss asks peers first, origin last
(falls back to direct S3 if dart is down)
falls back to direct S3 (no stall)
Pod: fastlet (anti-affinity vs A, lands on B)
same as A: driver + agent UDS
microVM slots x5 - first pull on this node served by A's dart peer (default P2P path)
hostPath: same as node A (/opt · /run · /var/lib shared host paths)

svg.text: DART peer :9000 (discovery: headless svc dns:dart.fast-sandbox-system.svc:9000)
per-node state roots on one XFS filesystem: node A binds /var/lib/fast-sandbox/control-plane, node B binds .../worker (same containerPath) - images / agent journal / jails stay private per node

reflink CoW still works (same filesystem, per-node subtree); one node's committed cache never satisfies another node's pull - peer -> origin is exercised on EVERY node's first create; down purges both
Docker: MinIO (kind network · container-IP:9000 = in-cluster endpoint)
bucket=sandbox-images: publish/index/(sha256(image)).json
-> manifest.json -> rootfs.ext4 / vmstate.snap / memory.snap
publish/pull credentials split; agent only hands out presigned URLs (AK never leaves)
up artifacts and assertions
kind load x7: controller·fastlet·fastlet-proxy·sandbox-proxy
·janitor·agent·egress (builder only with BUILD_TEMPLATE=1)
asserts: dartUp=true · roster=node count · pool conditions · actions/status echo

svg.text: 3. On-demand P2P delivery (default data plane) - first sandbox create on node B

g.text: 2 capacity-heartbeat placement -> Sandbox CR (full pool = ResourceExhausted, no queue)
3 PinImage(golden set) - local cache miss triggers on-demand pull
4 GET /dart/(presigned S3 URL) - SigV4 signed by the agent
5 peer block request (full roster visible, per-block routing)
6 blocks cached on A served directly (peer hit)
7 only missing blocks fetch origin - ~once per 4MiB block cluster-wide
8 commit to node cache (final) -> fastlet reflink-restores the microVM (~33ms)

svg.text: Evidence: dart_block_source_total{source=cache|peer|origin} per node at :8147/metrics (WARM_IMAGES=1 asserts at up: origin ~ block total, peer > 0 across 2 nodes)
Knobs: KIND_SINGLE=1 -> single node, cache-only (poolMin auto 1); WARM_IMAGES=1 -> preheat at pool create (implies BUILD_TEMPLATE=1); default is on-demand
Cold pull ~80-100s (3.6GiB set) once per environment; later creates on the node: run RPC ~55ms; XFS reflink keeps per-instance rootfs copies at ~ms
4. egress actions channel - per-sandbox network policy attached by default
fastlet Pod zoomed (one per node · managed by firecracker-egress-pool)
fastlet container
- firecracker driver: sandbox create/delete, netns/tap slots
- lifecycle driver: ordered delivery to the egress Handler
- probe: infraComponents tcpConnect :18080
- mounts agent UDS (PinImage / leases)
policy updates go through fastctl update (re-sends SET_BINDING)
egress container (OpenSandbox image, built here)
- fleet profile: /_fastlet/v1/actions[/status]
- dns+nft: domain policy + per-subject chains
- NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW: rules, socket marks
- binds Pod loopback 127.0.0.1:18080 only
sidecar profile (no actions surface) not used - pool pins fleet
SET_BINDING
200 / status
firecracker microVM (after sandbox create)
- golden snapshot restore (reflink rootfs · per-clone netns)
- guest eth0 172.30.0.3 · execd :44772 (baked in image)
- guest resolver points at slot gateway -> DNS via egress
CA delivery: egress exports mitm-ca -> guest rootfs pre-boot
Outbound traffic path (data plane)
1. guest app -> slot gateway (DNAT into egress)
2. DNS proxy: domain match -> IP into dyn_v4 set
3. nft subj_(uid) chain: allowed passes, rest dropped
per-subject policy + credential vault, mutually isolated
guest egress enters the Pod-netns enforcement chain

g.text: Lifecycle (per sandbox, fastlet delivers in order to 127.0.0.1:18080)
3 sandbox.data-plane-ready: data plane active - policy enforced, vault pushable
4 REMOVE_BINDING: sandbox delete -> unload that subj_ chain, others untouched
binding state -> status.actionBindings[egress].state=Ready; egress restart replayed by fastlet (new instanceId)
Assertions at env-init time (built into pool_up, no sandboxes needed)
- fastlet Pods Ready >= poolMin (anti-affinity, one per node)
- egress container Ready in every fastlet Pod (image built in this repo)
environment init ends here - no sandboxes created; use verify-egress for multi-subject checks
